message:
fix(desktop): playback.mid keeps mid-piece tempo/meter marks; export dialog blocks empty submits (#160, #161) (#162)

midi.ts read only the first sound tempo + first time signature, so a tracked-tempo transcription played back at the head tempo and mid-piece meter changes never reached the SMF. The walk now collects (tick, bpm) marks from direction/sound elements and (tick, n/d) marks from attributes, deduped across parts, and emits one meta event each. openTies also moved inside the part loop so a tied note in one voice can no longer merge with a same-pitch note in another.

ExportDialog: the submit button now gates on the effective (checked AND unblocked) format list instead of anyChecked, so a selection of only blocked formats can no longer produce a zero-file 'done'.

Co-authored-by: Devin <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
